paper_title: New CAST Limit on the Axion-Photon Interaction
coupling_convention: |g_agamma| in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis
notes: CAST final vacuum-phase solar axion result (2013-2015 data): g_agamma < 0.66e-10 GeV^-1 at 95% C.L., mass-independent for m_a <~ 0.02 eV (coherence limit of the 9.26 m magnet). Encoded as flat bound from ~1e-4 eV (lower edge of Fig. 2 exclusion plot) up to 0.02 eV; the true limit extends to arbitrarily low masses. Above 0.02 eV the limit degrades (shown only graphically in Fig. 2, no table provided).
